# octopusdeploy_webhook_trigger (Resource)

This resource manages webhook triggers in Octopus Deploy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "octopusdeploy_webhook_trigger" "my_trigger" {
  name        = "My webhook trigger"
  space_id    = "Spaces-1"
  description = "Runs a runbook when the webhook is called"
  project_id  = "Projects-1"
  secret      = "secret"

  run_runbook_action = {
    runbook_id             = "Runbooks-1"
    target_environment_ids = ["Environments-1"]
  }
}

# Authenticate with an Octopus API key instead of a shared secret
resource "octopusdeploy_webhook_trigger" "my_api_key_trigger" {
  name            = "My API key webhook trigger"
  space_id        = "Spaces-1"
  description     = "Runs a runbook when the webhook is called"
  project_id      = "Projects-1"
  require_api_key = true

  run_runbook_action = {
    runbook_id             = "Runbooks-1"
    target_environment_ids = ["Environments-1"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of this resource.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to attach the trigger.
- `run_runbook_action` (Attributes) Runs a runbook when the trigger fires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--run_runbook_action))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of this webhook trigger.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the trigger from being run when set.
- `require_api_key` (Boolean) Authenticate using an Octopus API key, sent in the 'X-Octopus-ApiKey' header.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret used to authenticate incoming webhook requests, sent in the 'X-Octopus-Webhook-Secret' header. Required unless 'require_api_key' is set.
- `space_id` (String) The space ID associated with this webhook trigger.
- `tenant_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the tenants trigger should apply to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.
- `webhook_id` (String) The server generated identifier used in the webhook URL that invokes this trigger.

<a id="nestedatt--run_runbook_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `run_runbook_action`

Required:

- `runbook_id` (String) The ID of the runbook to run.
- `target_environment_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the environments to run the runbook in. At least one is required.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import [options] octopusdeploy_webhook_trigger.<name> <trigger-id>
```
